acceptance: Decide per limit (document as accepted, or close) with evidence of how often it can occur in real captured plans; do not widen the detector to every absolute path (owner decision 2026-11-08).
If closed: add the case to the shared detector or sanitizer with allowlist false-positive tests and a publish dry-run smoke.
Otherwise record the accepted limit in the privacy docs.
context: Low priority: publish already fails closed on any residual leak. Verification rubric: tests for each closed case, allowlist tests unchanged, comment-policy and ruff, PR merged with green CI.
description: Documented limits of the merged detector (PR #4054): a custom $HOME is used for redaction but not as a leak-scan root; paths outside the known roots (for example /srv/...) are flagged only when configured; anonymize_plans_payload does not touch top-level errors, so a leak there is rejected at publish instead of redacted. These are accepted limits, not confirmed leaks.
